subject: general
question: Who among the following is the chairman of NITI Aayog?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narendra Modi **is **the chairman of NITI Aayog.**
 
• **The NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) **is the Government of India's apex public policy think tank and the nodal agency tasked with catalysing economic development and fostering cooperative federalism through bottom-up participation of State Governments in the economic policy-making process.
 
• The NDA government established it in 2015 to replace the Planning Commission, which operated on a top-down paradigm.
 
• All state Chief Ministers, as well as the Chief Ministers of Delhi and Puducherry, Lieutenant Governors of all UTs, and a vice-chairman appointed by the Prime Minister, make up the NITI Aayog council.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Narendra Damodardas Modi** is an Indian politician who has been the country's fourteenth and current Prime Minister since 2014. Modi served as Gujarat's chief minister from 2001 to 2014 and is a Varanasi Member of Parliament.
 
• **Rajiv Kumar** is an Indian economist who previously served as the NITI Aayog's second vice-chairman.
 
• **Amitabh Kant **is the second and current chief executive officer of NITI Aayog, the government of India's public policy think tank.
 
• **Nirmala Sitharaman** is an Indian politician and economist who has served as India's Minister of Finance and Corporate Affairs since 2019.
